bead.title: FZ-061 Execute DDx Fizeau pre-release import bump
bead.description:
In the DDx repo, consume the Fizeau pre-release from FZ-063 and migrate the downstream integration surfaces that still point at the old agent identity.

In-scope DDx changes:
- Go module/import path: replace github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/agent with github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau and pin the Fizeau pre-release tag produced by FZ-063.
- Config/env surface: update DDx configuration, harness wiring, documentation, examples, and env passthrough from old AGENT_* / ddx-agent assumptions to the renamed FIZEAU_* / fizeau surfaces where DDx invokes or configures the runtime.
- Binary surface: update DDx command discovery, harness invocation, installer/test fixtures, and docs that expect the old ddx-agent/agent binary so they call or describe fiz instead.

Out of scope:
- Pinning the final non-prerelease Fizeau tag; that is FZ-064.
- Rewriting historical DDx evidence or archived docs that intentionally preserve old names.
bead.acceptance:
In the DDx repo after FZ-063 is available:
1. go.mod/go.sum pin github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau at the Fizeau pre-release tag, and active Go imports no longer reference github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/agent.
2. DDx config/env/harness surfaces that invoke or configure this runtime use FIZEAU_* / fizeau names, with any retained AGENT_* references limited to documented compatibility or historical-only contexts.
3. DDx binary invocation, install/test fixtures, and active docs use the fiz binary name instead of ddx-agent/agent where they refer to this runtime.
4. DDx verification passes: go test ./... and a rename grep/static check showing no active github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/agent, ddx-agent, or AGENT_* runtime references remain outside explicit historical/compat allowlists.
